crons.//: THE PRODUCT HAS EXACTLY ONE CLOCK and this is it: stale-stage rules, approval expiry and the 'Wait, then…' queue all drain from this single sweep. Do not add a second cron entry for delays — the sweep already drains them. SCHEDULE: dropped from '*/5 * * * *' to daily because the Vercel Hobby plan allows at most ONE cron invocation PER DAY and refuses to deploy anything finer. That is a billing constraint, not a design choice, and it points the wrong way: at daily, the default flow's 15-minute pre-call reminder and 30-minute post-call wait fire up to 24 hours late, so time-based automation is effectively off — silently, with nothing logged. Restore '*/5 * * * *' on a Pro plan, or drive GET /api/automations/sweep from an external scheduler every 5 minutes with the CRON_SECRET bearer token. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md §7 and docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md B-05.
